model.name: Qwen Image 2.1 GGUF Q8_0 7B
model.description: DiT GGUF Q8_0 (7.7 GB) from leejet. Near-INT8 quality, slower than ConvRot on NVIDIA because GGUF bypasses Comfy/mmgp weight streaming. Still needs the 2.1 VAE and Qwen3-VL-8B encoder. License follows Qwen Research License.
model.selector_help: Use on a 4090 only if INT8 ConvRot misbehaves. Q8 is the highest GGUF. Default 1024; 2048 is heavier. Encoder is still the INT8/BF16 safetensors, not GGUF.

resource_requirements.note: INT8 ConvRot is faster on NVIDIA. GGUF helps older AMD.
